entries.target: Linear-fractional normal form; equivalence with head complexity

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.HStar_eq_Lfrac
declarations.statement: HStar n f = Lfrac n f

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.SharedHStar_eq_Lfrac
declarations.statement: SharedHStar n f = Lfrac n f

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.computableWithSharedHeadsN_iff_fracComputable
declarations.statement: computableWithSharedHeadsN n H f ↔ fracComputable n H f

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.HStar_eq_zero_iff
declarations.statement: HStar n f = 0 ↔ ∀ x y, f x = f y

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.HStar_eq_one_iff
declarations.statement: HStar n f = 1 ↔ (¬ (∀ x y, f x = f y) ∧ isLTF f)

gaps: Paper states H* ≤ 1 iff LTF; Lean states H* = 1 iff nonconstant LTF. Bridging lemma unnamed (ROADMAP R-002).

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.degree_le_of_computableWithHeadsN
declarations.statement: computableWithHeadsN n H f → ThresholdDegLE f H

gaps: Stated per head count H rather than as thresholdDeg f ≤ HStar n f (ROADMAP R-002).

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.thresholdDeg_f10
declarations.statement: thresholdDeg f10 = 2

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.HStar_f10_ge_three
declarations.statement: 3 ≤ HStar 10 f10

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.f10_strict_separation
declarations.statement: thresholdDeg f10 < HStar 10 f10

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.HStar_le_weighted_sum
declarations.statement: (∀ i, 0 < lam i) → (∀ bits, f bits = G (wT lam bits)) → HStar n f ≤ (Finset.univ.image (wT lam)).card - 1

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.HStar_le_universal_boolean
declarations.statement: HStar n f ≤ 2 ^ n - 1

entries.target: Exact characterization for symmetric Boolean functions: H*(f) = deg±(f) = C(F)

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.HStar_symmetricFn
declarations.statement: HStar n (symmetricFn F) = signChanges n F

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.thresholdDeg_symmetricFn
declarations.statement: thresholdDeg (symmetricFn F) = signChanges n F

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.HStar_thresholdDeg_signChanges_symmetricFn
declarations.statement: HStar n (symmetricFn F) = thresholdDeg (symmetricFn F) ∧ thresholdDeg (symmetricFn F) = signChanges n F

entries.notes: H* = C(F) is upstream; deg± = C(F) is fork EXT-005 (R-001, 2026-11-02). Definition-level correspondence (thresholdDeg vs paper footnote 2, profile domain, change count shift) recorded in CROSSWALK.md.
adjacent_gaps: The paper's remark that permutation-invariant f are exactly the functions with a Hamming-weight profile (Paturi 1992) has no Lean statement; Lean represents symmetric functions as symmetricFn F. Outside the statement of Theorem 5 (ROADMAP R-005).

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.HStar_parity
declarations.statement: HStar n (PARITY n) = n

entries.notes: Paper states n ≥ 1; the Lean declaration holds for every n, including n = 0.

entries.paper_ref: Appendix C (research plan); Appendix D in bundled PDF
entries.target: Comparison with Hsu–Xu and other concurrent results
gaps: Appendix letter differs between research plan (C) and bundled PDF (D); arXiv version unconfirmed.

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.signChanges_parity
declarations.statement: signChanges n (fun k => decide (Odd k)) = n

entries.notes: Found already proved upstream for every n, including n = 0; reclassified as reproduction. Superseded as a research target by EXT-001 to EXT-004.

entries.target: Sign-change count at most n; symmetric head complexity at most n

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.signChanges_le
declarations.statement: signChanges n F ≤ n

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.HStar_symmetricFn_le
declarations.statement: HStar n (symmetricFn F) ≤ n

entries.notes: Head form is a remark in the paper (λ = 1 in Theorem 4) and in upstream theorems.md; this is its first named Lean declaration.

entries.target: Complement invariance of the sign-change count and of symmetric head complexity

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.signChanges_not
declarations.statement: (signChanges n fun k => !F k) = signChanges n F

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.HStar_not_symmetricFn
declarations.statement: (HStar n fun bits => !symmetricFn F bits) = HStar n (symmetricFn F)

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.HStar_not_parity
declarations.statement: (HStar n fun bits => !PARITY n bits) = n

entries.target: Maximal sign changes iff every adjacent profile value flips

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.signChanges_eq_self_iff
declarations.statement: signChanges n F = n ↔ ∀ k < n, F (k + 1) = !F k

entries.target: Parity and its complement are the only maximal-complexity symmetric Boolean functions

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.signChanges_eq_self_iff_parity
declarations.statement: signChanges n F = n ↔ (∀ k ≤ n, F k = decide (Odd k)) ∨ ∀ k ≤ n, F k = !decide (Odd k)

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.HStar_symmetricFn_eq_self_iff
declarations.statement: HStar n (symmetricFn F) = n ↔ symmetricFn F = PARITY n ∨ symmetricFn F = fun bits => !PARITY n bits

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.HStar_symmetricFn_zero_cases
declarations.statement: HStar 0 (symmetricFn F) = 0 ∧ (symmetricFn F = PARITY 0 ∨ symmetricFn F = fun bits => !PARITY 0 bits)

entries.notes: Corollary of the upstream symmetric characterization; scoped to symmetric Boolean functions in the paper's model. Absent from the upstream library, upstream prose, and bundled paper text (search in VERIFICATION.md).

entries.target: Threshold degree of a symmetric function equals its profile's change count; completes paper Theorem 5 (H* = deg± = C(F))

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.ThresholdDegLE_symmetricFn
declarations.statement: ThresholdDegLE (symmetricFn F) (signChanges n F)

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.thresholdDeg_symmetricFn
declarations.statement: thresholdDeg (symmetricFn F) = signChanges n F

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.HStar_eq_thresholdDeg_symmetricFn
declarations.statement: HStar n (symmetricFn F) = thresholdDeg (symmetricFn F)

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.HStar_thresholdDeg_signChanges_symmetricFn
declarations.statement: HStar n (symmetricFn F) = thresholdDeg (symmetricFn F) ∧ thresholdDeg (symmetricFn F) = signChanges n F

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.thresholdDeg_symmetricFn_zero
declarations.statement: thresholdDeg (n := 0) (symmetricFn F) = 0

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.thresholdDeg_symmetricFn_one
declarations.statement: thresholdDeg (n := 1) (symmetricFn F) = if F 0 = F 1 then 0 else 1

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.thresholdDeg_symmetricFn_const
declarations.statement: thresholdDeg (symmetricFn fun _ => b) = 0

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.thresholdDeg_parity_of_symmetricFn
declarations.statement: thresholdDeg (PARITY n) = n

declarations.name: HeadComplexity.Ext.thresholdDeg_not_parity
declarations.statement: (thresholdDeg fun bits => !PARITY n bits) = n

entries.notes: Stated in the paper (Theorem 5, citing Aspnes et al. 1994, Lemma 2.6); first Lean declaration for a general profile. Upstream thresholdDeg_parity covers the parity profile only and is rederived here as a corollary.
